title: Blooming Dreams

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered couture gown with a sculpted corset bodice, voluminous tiered tulle skirt, and a fitted high-neck lace collar. The silhouette is accented by detached puff sleeves and sheer floating overskirt panels.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate floral crown of lavender roses and sweet peas, entwined with miniature iridescent butterfly hairpins and trailing pearl-and-crystal vine ribbons.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A structured corset bodice of metallic filigree and floral embroidery, paired with a high-neck Chantilly lace collar. Detached sheer puff sleeves with pearl-encrusted cuffs cascade into flowing tulle arm drapes.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous A-line skirt formed by layers of pleated tulle and iridescent organza, featuring a central split reveal. The hem is bordered with silver floral beadwork, worn over opaque white lace-trimmed stockings and pearl-embellished heeled sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Translucent, vein-textured fairy wings with iridescent shimmer, floating luminescent butterflies, and a scattering of glowing petal motes that trail from the gown's hem.
